headline: Integration paths
description: These are the integration paths the repository can honestly support today. They are smaller than a full production streaming estate, yet they are substantive enough to run, test, extend, and question.

available_now.title: Browser or Node wrapper
available_now.why: Wrap a prompt and drafted response in a compact, inspectable guard surface.

available_now.title: Local review API
available_now.why: Use FastAPI endpoints for runtime review, drift probing, music analysis, and static export parity.

available_now.title: Static artifact build
available_now.why: Rebuild the browser-facing JSON artifacts from the same backend path used by the live API.

available_now.title: Containerized local service
available_now.why: Run the API and the runtime ledger in one reproducible local service without hand-assembling the environment.

available_now.title: SQLite-backed runtime history
available_now.why: Persist runtime snapshots locally with a hash-linked ledger so contributors can inspect run order instead of relying on memory alone.

available_now.title: Rolling event ingress
available_now.why: Ingest live music-market events, keep them in a replayable local table, and recompute weighted pressure metrics on each window refresh.

available_now.title: Ingress contract and filtered window reads
available_now.why: Expose field expectations, batch limits, retention rules, and filterable reads before anyone treats the live lane as trustworthy.

available_now.title: Optional Redpanda and ClickHouse transport
available_now.why: Publish event batches and live metric receipts into a distributed bus and an analytical store when those sinks are wired in the environment.

available_now.title: Make targets and environment contract
available_now.why: Lower the setup burden for contributors while keeping the runtime contract visible and inspectable.
